level0_descriptor: missing, unsupported or materially contradictory result
partial_descriptor: substantive partial implementation or experiment with accurately stated missing results and boundaries
full_descriptor: Original predictions and identified fixture; complete closed P02 translation; combined filters, literal-percent search, three sorts, ID tie-breaker, bounded projection, rejected inputs and valid recovery; short file reopen/reset result

level0_descriptor: no traceable actual evidence; copied expected output does not become execution
partial_descriptor: some genuine evidence is traceable but a required witness or edit-boundary check is missing
full_descriptor: Exact inputs, commands, actual ORM/SQLite and local HTTP excerpts, distinct counter/spy witness for zero calls, genuine named checks, protected-file result and traceable lifecycle stages

level0_descriptor: description is absent or contradicts the implementation/evidence
partial_descriptor: mechanism is partly explained but one important causal link is missing or unsupported
full_descriptor: Explains validation before querying, exact tokens, fresh options/input preservation, options versus rows, literal substring/ASCII-case limit, deterministic ties and memory versus owned file/reset

level0_descriptor: no actual interaction/independent check, or synthetic practice presented as actual
partial_descriptor: genuine claim is identified but its independent check, verdict or limitation is incomplete
full_descriptor: Actual bounded interaction, sanitised prompt, one selected claim, Observed/Inferred/Unknown classification, independent non-AI check, justified verdict, correction and limit

level0_descriptor: missing reflection or unsupported universal claim
partial_descriptor: reflection is relevant but a limit, counterexample or next check is vague
full_descriptor: Specific untested boundary, honest counterexample, mechanism-based reflection and personal exit ticket; no universal claim from a small test set

level0_descriptor: missing/unreadable file or essential identity/declaration absent
partial_descriptor: readable PDF with a limited format/completeness defect
full_descriptor: One readable inspected PDF, correct current identity/filename, all required fields, honest provenance and renewed declaration
